mystery.en: But the true identity of Dread Pirate Roberts was still a mystery.
mystery.zh: 但 Dread Pirate Roberts 的真实身份仍然是一个谜。

mystery.en: And for our first mini-series of the year, the first of 2025, the loose theme will be “mystery”.
mystery.zh: 作为我们今年的第一个迷你系列，也就是2025年的第一个系列，本系列的主题是“神秘”。

mystery.en: There is also mystery and myths around the Great Wall.
mystery.zh: 围绕长城也有许多神秘和传说。

mystery.en: And as prices declined, Mike Francis cleared up a mystery.
mystery.zh: 随着房价下跌，迈克·弗朗西斯解开了一个谜团。

mystery.en: It provided a unifying explanation for many scientific mysteries like fossils, biodiversity, and the similarities among species.
mystery.zh: 它为化石、生物多样性以及物种间的相似性等许多科学谜题提供了一种统一的解释。

mysterious.en: Yes, I think 'strange', 'mysterious' and 'fantastic' describe being a twin quite well.
mysterious.zh: 是的，我觉得“奇怪”、“神秘”和“神奇”把双胞胎的特质描述得很贴切。

mysterious.en: Anand used the adjective eerie, meaning strange in a frightening, mysterious way.
mysterious.zh: Anand使用了形容词eerie，意思是令人感到害怕、神秘般的奇怪。

mysterious.en: Hardy filled with new mathematical results, including those mysterious mock theta functions.
mysterious.zh: Hardy信中充满了新的数学结果，包括那些神秘的仿θ函数。

mysterious.en: That “somewhere else” isn’t a mysterious cloud floating above your head.
mysterious.zh: 那个“其他地方”并不是漂浮在你头顶上的神秘云端。

mysterious.en: And in part three we will discuss some mysterious lost civilisations.
mysterious.zh: 在第三部分中，我们将讨论一些神秘的失落文明。

myth.en: These stories were myths and laws and guides and history all in one.
myth.zh: 这些故事集神话、法律、向导和历史于一身。

myth.en: Stories like this give us a chance right now to talk about myths, legends, and folklore.
myth.zh: 像这样的故事正好让我们有机会聊聊神话、传说和民间故事。

myth.en: A myth is usually a traditional story involving gods or supernatural explanations of the world.
myth.zh: 神话通常是涉及神灵或对世界做出超自然解释的传统故事。

myth.en: But there's lots of myths about these super foods and wonder oils and wonder this and that.
myth.zh: 但关于这些超级食物、神奇油类以及各种奇效东西，有很多神话般的传言。

myth.en: There is also mystery and myths around the Great Wall.
myth.zh: 围绕长城也有许多神秘和传说。
